attributes.name: Spiny Eurypterid
attributes.powers:
If the Spiny Eurypterid would defeated, reroll the dice. The Spiny Eurypterid is defeated or undefeated based solely on the result of the second die roll. 

If the check to defeated includes the Strength or Melee trait, after you act, the Spiny Eurypterid deals 1d4 Combat damage to you.
